       MIN(t.title) AS series_named_after_char
FROM aka_name AS an,
     cast_info AS ci,
     company_name AS cn,
     keyword AS k,
     movie_companies AS mc,
     movie_keyword AS mk,
     name AS n,
     title AS t
WHERE cn.country_code ='[us]'
  AND k.keyword ='character-name-in-title'
